items.title: Andy Hertzfeld oral history
items.blurb: Andy Hertzfeld was born in 1953 in Philadelphia, studied applied math and CS at Brown, and pursued a PhD in CS at Berkeley. After seeing the Apple II debut in 1977, he started writing, publishing and selling Apple II software.

items.title: What I find interesting about this video is that the game was developed by a small but highly professional team.
items.blurb: Yes, the game development industry wasn’t nearly as complex as it is today. You could probably say that making and releasing a good game was easier back then. But these people created a legend precisely because they were professionals.
